main_text.p: Apud te: אֲבָנָא [?] Nobiscum: נְבָךְ [?] Ad te, Job.4.5. צֶבִי מִיתִי [?] מִשֶּׁה [?] Super, de morte Mosis: נְבָה [?] Juxta se, Gen.39.16. in Jonath. אֲבִי מִדְבְּחָא [?] Super altari, Lev.22.27. in T.Hierosol. שְׂעַר גֵּב הַחַזָּה [?] Crinis super pectore, &c. Frequenter עַל נְבִי [?] Super: נְבָאִי [?] Collector eleemosynæ, à גֵּבָ [?] Elevare, id est, à singulis colligere.
גְּבוּל [?] · גְּבֻל [?] Terminus: גְּבוּל הַמִּשְׁפָּט [?] Terminus propositionis, Extremum: גְּבוּל אֶמְצַע [?] Terminus medius, apud Logicos. גְּבֻלָּה [?] Categoria, Prædicamentum determinatum.

נְבַר [?] Prævalere. גְּבִירָה [?] Potentia. Est & unum ex decem Numerationibus, sive Prædicamentis cabalisticis, & apud vulgatos Rabbinos unum ex decem Nominibus Dei, ut: שֶׁכָּךְ נֶאֱמַר לוֹ מִפִּי גְּבוּרָה [?] Quod sic dictum est ipsi ex ore Dei, Kimchi, Jos.7. infine. גִּבְרָן [?] Virilis. Fœminin. אִשָּׁה גִּבֹּרָה [?] Mulier virilis & perita, Kafvenaki, וּדְעָתָנִי [?] Prov.12.4.
ה [?] Sepire: metaphoricè Definire, Describere, Circumscribere: נָתַגְדֵּר [?] Definiri. גֶּדֶר [?] Definitio: גֶּדֶר הָאָדָם [?] Definitio hominis, quod est animal loquens.

גְּנֵו [?] Medium: Constructè, בְּנוֹ יָמָּא [?] In medium maris, Exod. 14.22. לְגוֹ [?] idem. Scribitur etiam cum Kametz & Tzere: מִגּוֹ [?] Ab intra: לְגוֹ · לְגָיו [?] Intus: מִלְּגָיו [?] Intrinsecus: בְּגוֹיָה [?] In medio ejus: בִּיתָא גַּוּאָה [?] Domus interior, Chald.
גּוֹן [?] Color: metaphoricè Modus, forma, similitudo: כְּהָאי גּוֹנָא [?] Secundum hunc modum, Ruth.4.6. וּכְהָאי גּוֹנָא [?] Et his similia, Et id genus alia.

גּוּף [?] Substantia, Corpus: עוֹשָׂה גּוּפָנִי [?] Corporalis: גּוּפָנִי [?] Pœna corporalis. Fœmin. תָּאוֹה גּוּפָנִיָּה [?] Concupiscentia corporalis. גּוּפָנִי [?] & גּוּפָנִית idem. Item שְׁלֹשָׁה גּוּפִים [?] Tres personæ Deitatis.

page.notes: The Hebrew and the few unclear Latin words are approximate and marked [?]; the Hebrew vowel points and letters were hard to read at this scan resolution. The page number's last digit is blurred and read as 5. The small mark at top centre is not clearly a running head and was left out. The stray mark near the bottom left and the digitiser's watermark at bottom right were left out.
